comment: Grandfathered sites of the ratcheted rules of lint_kubejs_traps.js (ID-SET, ENTITY-TYPE, BLOCK-READ, DIRECT-HURT-REG, HELPER-COPY). A file may hold at most this many sites of the rule; a file that is not listed may hold none. `started` is the day the rule got its first counts (--ratchet-start=<RULE>, once). Counts go DOWN only (--ratchet-down after fixing some); never raise one by hand: fix the new site, or record it in lint_kubejs_traps.exceptions.json with the reason it is right. --ratchet-base=<ref> (pre-push hook, CI) refuses a count that rose.
